Look up flag (country) names by code

lookup_flagname.Rd

Returns the full and abbreviated name(s) corresponding to one or more flag codes. Results are sourced from ref.countries on first call and cached for the rest of the session — subsequent calls (including single-code lookups like lookup_flagname("VN")) filter the cached table locally rather than re-querying the database.

Usage

lookup_flagname(flag = NULL, simplify = FALSE, refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

flag

Optional character vector of flag codes to filter by. If NULL, all flags are returned.

simplify

Logical. If TRUE, return a named character vector of flag_name, named by flag_code, rather than the full tibble. Defaults to FALSE.

refresh

Logical. Force a re-query of the database and refresh the cache. Defaults to FALSE.

Details

flag_name and flag_name_abbr are sentence-cased and trimmed via stringr::str_to_sentence()/stringr::str_trim(). Where flag_name_abbr is missing, it is filled with flag_name.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lookup_flagname()
lookup_flagname(flag = c("JP", "KR"))
lookup_flagname("VN")
#>       VN
#> "Vietnam"
lookup_flagname(refresh = TRUE) # force a fresh pull from the database
} # }
